objective_value: <float> Total cost combining weighted tardiness penalties and nonregular capacity costs.

orders_solution.order_id: <int> Unique identifier of the order this entry refers to.
orders_solution.chosen_interval: <list[int], length 2> Start and finish periods of the contiguous execution window assigned to the order.
orders_solution.intensities: <dict, key: '{period}'> Fraction of the order's total work content performed in each period during its execution window.

nonregular_capacity_by_period: <dict, key: '{period}'> Amount of nonregular (overtime) capacity used in each period where it is positive.
